confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from several Melbourne price sources (travel and cost-of-living guides, crowdsourced indexes, a menu-price survey). Many of these sources are undated and disagree, so restaurant anchors are medium confidence and beer, cocktail and wine are lower. Wine and cocktail rest on limited direct Melbourne figures, cross-checked against the local beer price level. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX observation is the RBA exchange-rates page figure surfaced in search, dated 2026-03-20, so it is not the latest observation. A later secondary-source figure from early November 2026 was not used because it is not from an RBA source. Verify the latest RBA F11.1 observation before relying on the USD conversions, which used the reported rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used. Food and drink anchors are based on Melbourne-specific aggregated sources, with wine and cocktail also cross-checked against the local beer price level as a judgement. Accommodation anchors are a holistic model estimate for Melbourne hostel and hotel lodging.
